def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", len(customers))

    if not customers:
        return []

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    def route_load(r):
        s = 0
        for x in r:
            s += demands[x]
        return s

    def route_cost(r):
        if not r:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][r[0]] + matrix[r[-1]][depot]
        for k in range(len(r) - 1):
            c += matrix[r[k]][r[k + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        s = 0
        for r in routes:
            s += route_cost(r)
        return s

    def best_2opt(r):
        # deterministic first-improvement 2-opt
        n = len(r)
        if n < 4:
            return r
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            for i in range(n - 3):
                a = r[i]
                b = r[i + 1]
                for j in range(i + 2, n - 1):
                    c = r[j]
                    d = r[j + 1]
                    old = matrix[a][b] + matrix[c][d]
                    new = matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]
                    if new < old:
                        r = r[:i + 1] + list(reversed(r[i + 1:j + 1])) + r[j + 1:]
                        improved = True
                        n = len(r)
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
        return r

    def try_relocate(routes, max_passes=4):
        # deterministic best-improvement per pass: move one node into another route
        if len(routes) <= 1:
            return routes
        loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
        base = total_cost(routes)

        for _ in range(max_passes):
            best_delta = 0
            best_move = None  # (ri, pos, rj, ins)

            for ri in range(len(routes)):
                r1 = routes[ri]
                if not r1:
                    continue
                if len(r1) == 1:
                    # still allow moving last node
                    pass
                for pos in range(len(r1)):
                    node = r1[pos]
                    new_load_r1 = loads[ri] - demands[node]
                    for rj in range(len(routes)):
                        if rj == ri:
                            continue
                        if loads[rj] + demands[node] > capacity:
                            continue
                        r2 = routes[rj]
                        # insert positions 0..len(r2)
                        for ins in range(len(r2) + 1):
                            r1_new = r1[:pos] + r1[pos + 1:]
                            r2_new = r2[:ins] + [node] + r2[ins:]
                            # capacity check already done for rj; for ri it will always be <= capacity
                            old_cost = route_cost(r1) + route_cost(r2)
                            new_cost_pair = route_cost(r1_new) + route_cost(r2_new)
                            improvement = old_cost - new_cost_pair
                            if improvement > best_delta + 1e-12:
                                best_delta = improvement
                                best_move = (ri, pos, rj, ins)

            if best_move is None:
                break
            if best_delta <= 1e-12:
                break

            ri, pos, rj, ins = best_move
            node = routes[ri][pos]
            routes[ri] = routes[ri][:pos] + routes[ri][pos + 1:]
            routes[rj] = routes[rj][:ins] + [node] + routes[rj][ins:]

            loads[ri] -= demands[node]
            loads[rj] += demands[node]

            # purge empty routes
            if any(len(r) == 0 for r in routes):
                newr = []
                for r in routes:
                    if len(r) > 0:
                        newr.append(r)
                routes = newr
                loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
            base = total_cost(routes)

        return routes

    def try_swap(routes, max_passes=3):
        # deterministic best-improvement swap of one node between two routes
        if len(routes) <= 1:
            return routes
        loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
        for _ in range(max_passes):
            best_delta = 0
            best_move = None  # (ri, pi, rj, pj)
            for ri in range(len(routes)):
                r1 = routes[ri]
                if not r1:
                    continue
                for pi in range(len(r1)):
                    a = r1[pi]
                    load1_new = loads[ri] - demands[a]
                    for rj in range(ri + 1, len(routes)):
                        r2 = routes[rj]
                        if not r2:
                            continue
                        for pj in range(len(r2)):
                            b = r2[pj]
                            if load1_new + demands[b] > capacity:
                                continue
                            load2_new = loads[rj] - demands[b]
                            if load2_new + demands[a] > capacity:
                                continue
                            old_cost = route_cost(r1) + route_cost(r2)
                            r1_new = r1[:pi] + [b] + r1[pi + 1:]
                            r2_new = r2[:pj] + [a] + r2[pj + 1:]
                            new_cost_pair = route_cost(r1_new) + route_cost(r2_new)
                            improvement = old_cost - new_cost_pair
                            if improvement > best_delta + 1e-12:
                                best_delta = improvement
                                best_move = (ri, pi, rj, pj)
            if best_move is None or best_delta <= 1e-12:
                break
            ri, pi, rj, pj = best_move
            a = routes[ri][pi]
            b = routes[rj][pj]
            routes[ri] = routes[ri][:pi] + [b] + routes[ri][pi + 1:]
            routes[rj] = routes[rj][:pj] + [a] + routes[rj][pj + 1:]
            loads[ri] = loads[ri] - demands[a] + demands[b]
            loads[rj] = loads[rj] - demands[b] + demands[a]
        return routes

    # ---------- Construct with Clarke-Wright savings ----------
    routes = []
    for u in customers:
        routes.append([u])
    loads = [demands[r[0]] for r in routes]

    # Precompute pair savings for all i<j with deterministic tie-break
    sav = []
    m = matrix
    n = len(customers)
    for idx_a in range(n):
        i = customers[idx_a]
        di = m[depot][i]
        for idx_b in range(idx_a + 1, n):
            j = customers[idx_b]
            s = di + m[depot][j] - m[i][j]
            sav.append((s, i, j))
    sav.sort(key=lambda t: (-(t[0]), t[1], t[2]))

    def rebuild_endpoints(routes):
        start_owner = {}
        end_owner = {}
        for ri, r in enumerate(routes):
            if not r:
                continue
            start_owner[r[0]] = ri
            end_owner[r[-1]] = ri
        return start_owner, end_owner

    start_owner, end_owner = rebuild_endpoints(routes)

    # Merge only when i is end of one route and j is start of another (or swapped),
    # but also allow reversing the two routes to enable more merges deterministically.
    # This is a small yet impactful augmentation for bottleneck/structured cases.
    for s, i, j in sav:
        start_owner, end_owner = rebuild_endpoints(routes)
        if i in end_owner and j in start_owner:
            ra = end_owner[i]
            rb = start_owner[j]
            if ra != rb and loads[ra] + loads[rb] <= capacity:
                routes[ra] = routes[ra] + routes[rb]
                routes[rb] = []
                loads[ra] += loads[rb]
                loads[rb] = 0
        elif j in end_owner and i in start_owner:
            ra = end_owner[j]
            rb = start_owner[i]
            if ra != rb and loads[ra] + loads[rb] <= capacity:
                routes[ra] = routes[ra] + routes[rb]
                routes[rb] = []
                loads[ra] += loads[rb]
                loads[rb] = 0

        # purge empties occasionally to keep endpoint maps valid and avoid churn
        if len(routes) > hint + 30:
            if any(len(r) == 0 for r in routes):
                new_routes = []
                for r in routes:
                    if r:
                        new_routes.append(r)
                routes = new_routes
                loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]

        if len(routes) <= max(1, hint):
            # keep working but not excessively; deterministic stop condition
            if s <= 0:
                break

    routes = [r for r in routes if r]
    loads = [route_load(r) for r in routes]

    # ---------- Post-process: 2-opt within routes ----------
    for k in range(len(routes)):
        routes[k] = best_2opt(routes[k])

    # ---------- Inter-route local search (deterministic, replay-aware) ----------
    desc = instance.get("descriptors", {}) or {}
    demand_pressure = desc.get("demand_pressure", 0.0)
    # High pressure tends to benefit from extra relocation/swap to resolve tight capacity bottlenecks.
    rel_passes = 5 if demand_pressure >= 0.99 else 4
    swap_passes = 3 if demand_pressure >= 0.97 else 2

    routes = try_relocate(routes, max_passes=rel_passes)
    routes = try_swap(routes, max_passes=swap_passes)

    for k in range(len(routes)):
        routes[k] = best_2opt(routes[k])

    # Final feasibility purge
    out = []
    for r in routes:
        if r and route_load(r) <= capacity:
            out.append(r)
    return out
